title.narrative: Support to Stockholm International Peace Research Institutes Research Paper on Transitioning Civilian Common Security and Defence Policy Missions

description.narrative: The project supports the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI) in producing research and policy papers on how to create a more flexible and effective civilian Common Security and Defence Policy (CSDP). As such, SIPRI will produce tangible knowledge for EU member states to advance policy discussions on improving civilian CSDP mission closure and transition processes during this year’s Annual Review Conference (ARC), which will contribute to international stability and security in developing countries.
